 Google’s driverless car hits a roadblock
 Waymo, Google’s sister company under Alphabet, faces fresh scrutiny after a driverless car stalled in San Francisco floodwaters amid other traffic incidents. California has barred its vehicles from state highways, prompting it to pause driverless rides on highways across the US.
